_doc: Engine config for bc_flakes_dev-store/build.sh. The dev profile (heavy toolchain) is the `devProfile` package output of the DESKTOP flake (ba_flakes_desktop/src) — defined there so it reuses the correct pkgs overlays (unstable/customPkgs/nur) + inputs (DRY: the SAME leaf modules the pool imports). build.sh realises that output DIRECTLY into the p5 CHROOT store (storeDir=/nix/store, physical root on p5) so cache.nixos.org works AND the 80G pool (<7G free) is never touched. The `dev` bwrap launcher (ba_flakes_desktop/src/modules/programs/dev-shell.{nix,json}) puts <p5_root>/profile/bin on PATH inside the namespace. Plan: ../a0_tasks/PLAN_dev-store-split.md.
name: dev-store
description: Dev userspace — heavy dev toolchain in a p5 chroot store, reached via the `dev` bwrap shell
